steps.label: First example
steps.why: A muscle built by training changes only the body cells, not the reproductive cells, so nothing is passed on.
common_mistakes: Giving an inherited character as the example. It must be an acquired one.
Leaving out that it is NOT inherited.
steps.memory_tip: Training changes the body, never the germ cells.
steps.margin_note: Each example needs the words 'not inherited'.

steps.label: Second example
steps.why: A change made to the body from outside cannot reach the DNA in the reproductive cells.
common_mistakes: Giving only one example when two are asked.
Choosing an example that IS inherited.
steps.memory_tip: Pierced ears are made, not born, and are never passed on.
